evidence.claim: AGS Technologies (India) Pvt. Ltd. maintains an ISO 9001:2015 quality management certification and acts as a Maharashtra Fire Services Authorized Licensed Agency.
The company manufactures and supplies the SeQuraWorld brand of portable fire extinguishers certified under Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) norms.

Manufacturing & Quality Control.assessed_on: We verified the company's organizational certifications and product compliance standards, but was unable to verify specific production capacity figures or plant defect rates due to limited public manufacturing data, placing the company in the partial evidence score band.
